step_description: Identify transformer ID and confirm de-energization status if sampling oil-cooled
Open sampling valve and flush 200 ml of old oil
Draw representative sample into N2-purged syringe
Label and ship to certified lab within 24h
Review report against IEEE C57.104 Duval triangle
Schedule outage and de-energize transformer per LOTO
Disconnect bushings and ground
Connect Doble M4000 test set
Run PF + capacitance tests
Compare to baseline; report >0.7% PF or >5% C-change
Plan thermography route; print drawings
required_tool: IR camera (Fluke Ti or FLIR T-Series)

step_description: Open switchgear doors only if rated for energized work; otherwise use IR windows
Capture all bolted joints; record ΔT vs ambient
Flag hotspots ΔT >10 K as warning; >30 K as critical
Issue work order for hotspots
Plan UPS module bypass per OEM procedure
De-energize module and discharge DC bus to <50 V
Remove capacitor bank
Install new cap bank per OEM kit; torque to spec
Recommission per OEM procedure
Connect impedance meter (Alber/BTECH) at battery terminals
Measure impedance for all cells
Compare to baseline; flag any cell >25% above baseline
Issue work order for replacement string if pattern shows aging
Review previous month's PMs; confirm no impairments
Notify operations of test window
Position fuel selector at day-tank; verify fuel level
Place control to MANUAL; press START
Run no-load 30 min minimum; observe oil pressure / temp / V / Hz
Shut down; record run-time and any alarms
Connect resistive load bank (>=30% rated load)
Run 25% load 30 min; 50% 30 min; 75% 30 min; 100% 2 hr
Record exhaust temp; cylinder temps; coolant temp;DEF (if applicable)
Verify wet stacking is removed (no excessive smoke)
Cool-down at 20% load 10 min before shutdown
Schedule outage on UPS module (place to bypass)
Disconnect battery string at breaker
Connect ohmic discharge tester (BCT-200 or equivalent)
Discharge at 1-hr rate to 1.75 V/cell EOD
Compute Ah delivered vs rated; flag <80% as replace
Recharge per OEM (constant V then float)
Pull annual EPA 608 leak-rate report
Walk chiller and condenser; ultrasonic leak detector at all fittings
IR camera at brazed joints
Record findings;repair if leak >0.5 oz/yr
Mount accelerometers at bearing housings (DE + NDE)
Capture vibration spectrum at operating speed
Identify 1x; 2x; BPFI; BPFO peaks vs baseline
If ISO 10816 alarm; trend more frequently; plan replacement
Sample basin & makeup per ASHRAE 188 program
Send to certified lab for Legionella PCR
Track ORP; conductivity; LSI; biocide residual
Trigger hyperchlorination if PCR positive
Verify inline sensors are calibrated within 12 months
Trend pH; conductivity; TDS; ORP daily
Replace coolant if conductivity >5 µS/cm or pH out of 7-9
Initiate positioner diagnostic session
Run step test + ramp test
Review deadband; deviation; travel deviation
Identify sensor and tag
Connect traceable reference (e.g. dry-block or pressure pump)
Sweep 4 points (0/25/50/100%);record as-found / as-left
Adjust transmitter zero/span if drift >2x spec
Open valve room; confirm normal pressure
Operate solenoid via test switch; verify valve trips
Reset valve and supervisory pressure
Walk to cylinder room; read pressure gauge
Compare to OEM low-pressure limit
Weight check every 12 months; replace if mass <95%
Sample fuel from tank-bottom port; visual + water-paste
Send sample to lab for ASTM D7978 microbial test
Polish fuel through 1-2 µm absolute filter
Add biocide per OEM dose rate
Walk floor; lift sample tiles in seismic-bracing zones
Torque pedestal-to-stringer fasteners to design value
Document and seal tile inspection log
